newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-DAHLIN EDGES CLOSER TO BLACKBURN MOVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DAHLIN EDGES CLOSER TO BLACKBURN MOVE.

text.p: Swedish striker Martin Dahlin said on Monday he would decide in the next few days whether to move to English premier league club Blackburn Rovers.
Dahlin said his Italian club Roma had agreed terms with Blackburn and it was now up to him to decide if he wanted to move to England.
Dahlin moved to Roma last year from Borussia Moenchengladbach but was unable to secure a first team spot and returned on loan to the German club.
"The clubs are completely agreed and I'm now going to have a good long think about it," he said, adding there were only minor contractual details still to be worked out.
"But it's basically down to me to decide and I shall take a decision in the next few days."

Blackburn manager Roy Hodgson knows Dahlin well and is trying hard to secure his signature. Dahlin was nurtured by Hodgson as a youngster with Swedish first division Malmo, where the Englishman was manager.
Hodgson was quoted by the Swedish news agency TT as saying that Blackburn were close to signing Dahlin.
Blackburn are due to travel to Sweden later this week as part of their pre-season build-up.
